usb_name_resolution.pin1: ioboard J3.1 USB_TX / IC25.25 TXD output → mainboard J3.1 USBRX / IC3.3 RXD1
usb_name_resolution.pin2: mainboard J3.2 USB_TX / IC3.4 TXD1 → ioboard J3.2 USB_RX / IC25.24 RXD input
usb_name_resolution.interpretation: The wiki USB TX/RX names correspond to the I/O USB bridge perspective. Pin1→pin1 and pin2→pin2 already connect transmitter to receiver. Do not cross physical pins by matching equal net strings across projects.
usb_name_resolution.evidence_type: Direction interpretation follows explicit current schematic device pin functions; no historical cable crossing inferred.

documented_orientation.pin1_stripe: Original finishing manual explicitly says to match pin1 with the black stripe at both ends.
documented_orientation.signal_pin_numbers: Original wiki jumper table defines the24 conductor functions.
documented_orientation.physical_stock_pieces: Original finishing instructions specify four3-conductor pieces and two6-conductor pieces.
documented_orientation.connector_bodies: These are soldered jumper cables. MA03-1/MA12-1 are footprint names; no plastic header inferred.

assembly_interpretation.basis: Allocation of the two documented6-conductor pieces to the only12-pad group J3 follows the documented counts and actual row; this split assignment is a reconstruction inference, not an independently measured installed cable.
assembly_interpretation.black_stripe_for_second_J3_half: If rendering two adjacent6-conductor ribbons, mark the low-number edge of each corresponding half consistently at both ends. The second half begins at overallJ3.7; its exact historical ink placement is unmeasured.

scene_ambiguities: Pin mapping and actual2.54mm pad row are established. Conductor diameter, insulation profile, stripped length, bend radius, slack,3D cable route and installed length are not established.
Source stock length152.4mm in the earlier distributor/BOM map must not be treated as measured installed board separation.

Native endpoint XY is PCB(X,-Y). Apply the actual board world matrix once; do not infer world left/right from a flat board drawing. Mainboard F.Cu points inside the assembled case after its side flip.
Actual jumper footprints are on F.Cu and have retained pin-number marks. Whether each wire is bent immediately after a pad or a short straight segment is a scene construction choice.
J3 power and ground are duplicated on pins3/4 and7/8. Preserve all12 conductors despite equivalent nets.
This review validates the source map and schematic/PCB agreement, not physical cable fit or electrical continuity on hardware.
